objective: Publish the three-agent production-readiness plan and Looping Skill: coordinator-owned instructions, agent-owned overwrite-only response reports, independent evidence review between iterations, and human-approved credential setup.

okf.notes: Plan only. It preserves .okf hierarchy and release-evidence rules. Full repo-wide sweep must be performed by Agent 1 before implementation changes; this report does not claim coding-agent skill installation or live acceptance.

security.notes: Documentation-only coordination plan. No secrets, application runtime, workflows, auth or production settings changed. Required skills must be installed/verified in the three real agent environments.

changes: Added three-agent speedrun and release acceptance matrix.
Replaced three role-only agent packet files with exactly six paired instruction/response files and removed the superseded packet files.
Defined manual activation, per-agent IN_PROGRESS/final response overwrites, isolated response-only commits, independent GitHub evidence review, and coordinator-owned next-iteration handoffs.
Added a human-in-the-loop credential gate that forbids secret values in chat/reports and requires owner configuration/confirmation.
Kept production acceptance blocked pending controlled physical render, MP4/ffprobe, CAS/F07, Drive metadata/download identity, and post-restart retrieval.
evidence: The Looping Skill is present on this PR's coordination branch at .agents/skills/looping-skill/SKILL.md and registered in .agents/skills/AGENTS.md; this is repository documentation, not proof the skill has been merged or loaded in any agent's local session.
The agent-packets directory was verified on the coordination branch to contain exactly the six intended instruction/response files.
The updated protocol explicitly requires the owner to manually activate/reactivate each separate agent session; file changes do not auto-launch agents.
Each coding agent must independently verify skill load in its own actual environment before claiming that prerequisite is satisfied.
Previous live Render health evidence returned HTTP 200 while the application status was degraded; the scheduled worker dispatcher remains gated.
Lightning physical MP4→CAS→F07 run 40824025739 failed with exit code 1 and no proof artifacts.

verification.tests: Current-head Team Change Gate, OKF Governance Gate and CI are required; inspect final results after the last report/skill/doc changes.
verification.criterion: The handoff protocol and six-file limit are accurately documented; this PR does not establish agent execution or production acceptance.

blockedReason: This PR establishes coordination and a reusable Looping Skill only. Actual agents have not yet demonstrated successful looping runs from their response files. Production remains unaccepted until a genuine staging render and physical MP4/ffprobe, CAS/F07, Google Drive metadata/download identity, and retrieval-after-restart evidence pass.
